[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*]The Most Wanted bounty hunting feature. Fulfill Most Wanted contracts, which can be found [spoiler]on the Most Wanted boards at the trading post, the Miner's headquarters, and in Corpse Creek[/spoiler].

[*] Observatory (build to passively scout)
[*] Composite bow

[*] Restored Remington (new rifle)
[*] 7 Mystical feathers that permanently increase character stats (reputation reward)
[*] 6 Trophies (decoration, reputation reward)
[*] Bounty hunter’s gear (reputation reward)
[*] Enhanced fishing rod (increases fishing speed)
[*] Tooth Necklace IV

[*] Prairie to Lake

[/list]

[b]New Achievements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 3 new Most Wanted-related achievements.

[list]
[*] Length of day/night cycle is a slider in settings
[*] Petting the wolf companion restores sanity (now has cooldown).

[*] Adjusted and balanced various crafting recipes.
[*] You can now craft multiple items at once.

[list]
[*]A non-linear campaign - play through the stories in any order you desire or even in parallel!
[*]Total freedom, you choose which biomes to unlock first.
[*]Go on your own quests with your own goals in mind.
[*]Resources to unlock new biomes are calculated dynamically on which ones you have access to.
[*]Every journey can be different.
[*]The tutorial is skipped (no Hunter's Rest).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/90b1fa0108bde02ff7fce45fe9f9eabc8e1c158c.png[/img]

All of the stories (except for Hunter's Rest) are still contained in the game and can be unlocked at the player's choice. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/26f95e494a9a6ee30902ce7ccb42380081828dd0.png[/img]
In response to multiple requests, we are introducing an exciting addition to your map building capabilities: the mountains biome. Acting as a versatile wildcard, this new biome can be seamlessly integrated into your map, serving as both fillers and connectors. Mountains can be placed in (almost) any location, adapting their edges to match the surrounding biomes to ensure a visually pleasing result.

[h3]Upgrade Buildings[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/f23669b6c956e1dbaf82e0604fec7ccb2dd9d2f7.gif[/img]

[h3]Other Improvements[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/92160c9a3c1005ae8c0250e99bd0272cf63f9163.png[/img]
We also added a handful of quality of life improvements and bug fixes, such as item details being shown in storage chests.

[h2]20% Discount![/h2]
To celebrate the new update, Above Snakes is now [b]20% off[/b] until July 13.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1589120/Above_Snakes/

We hope you will enjoy the update and are as thrilled to play it as we are! :)
Let us know your thoughts in the comments below!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 - Targeting in Combat, Crop Farming, Watchtower Events
notes.notes:
[h2]Combat - Targeting[/h2]
We saw that many of you are not happy with the combat of the game. With this patch, we want to address one aspect of that: targeting. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/fb4f9198551739f2539bb02c78276693a577f4f8.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Controller: Drastically improved auto-aim for ranged weapons. You no longer target random bushes or trees - only enemies, wildlife, and bees.
[*] Mouse: When using a range weapon you can not accidentally click on a tree and shoot in a completely wrong direction anymore. Trees are no longer targeted while using a ranged weapon.
[*] Mouse: When using a melee weapon, trees are only getting targeted at the trunk (up to roughly 1,5x player height).
[/list]
Please be aware that this is the first of a series of improvements that we will make to combat, targeting and animations. We are not finished patching and adjusting.

[h2]Crop Farming[/h2]
We realized that the crop farming mechanic was not as meaningful as it should be and that in many cases it was not worth investing your resources into a garden. We want to change that with this patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/0b9d08e4bac7a554dc6504f1df8a713c83db5164.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Drastically reduces grow times for crops. They grow faster.
[*]Fertilizer and water hold for longer and they completely "fill" the garden with 1 use.
[*]Fertilizer and water have more impact on growth speed.
[*]Fertilizer and water now have an impact on the number of harvested crops.
[*]Sleeping in bed skips time and lets plants grow.
[/list]

[h2]Desert Watchtower Events[/h2]

We understood that some of you found the watchtower events tedious and we want to address that. The number of enemies that spawned was bugged and in some cases (the longer you pushed the button, the more enemies spawned). Therefore way too many enemies were spawned. Additionally, it was a bug, that it was necessary to loot enemies (which caused sanity to decrease).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/8dbac1078f8638ae63ec716c31ad16c102d64161.png[/img]

[list]
[*]The correct number of enemies spawn per watchtower event (2-3 enemies per wave).
[*]Corrected the number of waves (always 3 waves).
[*]It is no longer necessary to loot enemies to proceed.
[*]Fixed that skeleton gunman sometimes took no damage.
[*]Reduced sound volume of dynamite explosions.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Some improvements to RAM management of the game. More improvements will follow.
[*]Playstation controller: The correct interaction button for secondary interactions is shown ("circle").
[*]Fixed wrong world piece icon of "Snow-covered forest / Forest"
[*]Fixed that the world piece name was too big in some languages and overlapped the UI button.
[*]Prevent character names below portraits to flow out of the screen (some languages had that issue).
[*]Workbench UI: Fixed closing animation.
[*]Korean: Buttons for opening files and subscribing to Square Glade Club are now readable.
[*]You can no longer destroy the bonfire in Kacheda village with a hammer.
[*]Fixed various spelling mistakes and translations.
[/list]

The prologue covers about the first hour of Above Snakes gameplay and is meant for people to be introduced to the game for free and to provide any feedback regarding basic mechanics before release. Feel free to play it and share your feedback so we know where to improve. 

We intentionally planned for there to be some time in between the Above Snakes: Prologue and the release of the full game. That means that we've closed our development process for any new features or ideas and are now focusing on polishing the game and making it the best version of itself as possible. Next to fixing lots of bugs, we are also revisiting UI/UX, lighting, effects, and the overall performance of the game. Here is a recent example of improvements we've made to lighting:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/c1ad72384c4d2f171ca763f3ea1ffbcb291da367.png[/img]

notes.title: Release Cover Art Reveal!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/663fa638234bde6cdfe6adeb48a093bb6b56abf0.png[/img]

[h2]Video Version[/h2]

[previewyoutube=KYOate8HqHY;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello everyone, 

My name is Tobi and I am the lead developer of the team behind [i]Above Snakes[/i]. Today, I want to talk to you about the portrayal of our main character, Aiyana, and the exciting update we have given her! We wanted to take a moment to go in depth about why we chose certain design elements for this rework and why it was important to do so.

First and foremost, we want to say that we still love the original design of Aiyana. However, over the past two years, we have noticed that she is often mistaken as a fully native character when, in actuality, Aiyana is an individual that represents both the tribes of Above Snakes and its colonists. Aiyana's father descends from a tribe while her mother is a colonist from Corpse Creek (that’s all we can say without spoiling anything). As we are nearing the eventual full release of Above Snakes, it felt more important than ever to capture the essence of both in Aiyana’s design. 

Additionally, we were made aware that the original art featured some historical inaccuracies in Aiyana’s portrayal. We aimed to correct those errors. Despite Above Snakes being a work of fiction and fantasy, some design choices broke the illusion of a believable world as it didn’t properly represent the whole of Aiyana’s character or background. We are happy to say that we did our very best to amend these concerns and to better portray Aiyana as she truly is.

For the new artwork, we worked closely with Native American fans and volunteers who were kind enough to offer insight about how to best express Aiyana’s background and how to tease the larger story of Above Snakes. 

We want to offer a big thank you to the Native American gaming community for assisting and consulting with us during this exciting process! A lot of thought and hard work went into this new design. We also want to thank Lyubov Kolodeznikova for bringing this vision to life in such a beautiful way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/6f7bab1eaf880659335cfbb81af3165890ea77e1.png[/img]
[i]Full Artwork by Lyubov Kolodeznikova[/i]

Since we collectively put a great deal of thought and research into this new design, we want to highlight some key elements. Please keep in mind that, despite Above Snakes being a fantasy world, the game borrows heavily from the history of the American Wild West.

Firstly, we decided to stay away from feathers. Originally, we utilized feathers on Aiyana’s tomahawk and her bow but, historically, eagle feathers were considered to be a man's item.

Aiyana's dress is now a basic two-hide dress. The cream white color - due to the lack of heavily smoking the leather - are typical for Native American dresses from that period. Additionally, the dress is not heavily fringed on the sleeves. This style of dress could be anything from the northwest, Great Basin, the Great Plains, Great Lakes, and even representative of southwest cultures like the Jicarilla and Lipan Apache.

Aiyana is wearing white shell earrings that were common among many men and women west of the Mississippi River. They could be whelk shell from the southeast, wampum from the northeast, clam from the northwest, or pink concho (which is mostly white). In the southwest, it was common for men to wear headbands, but this was not a common practice for women. Therefore, we removed the headband.

Another key element to Aiyana’s updated look is her belt which would usually feature three items: a knife, a fire steel striker, and an awl. These were commonly found in historical depictions of Native American characters. In the case of Aiyana, we chose to go with a tomahawk to showcase her survival abilities - both for daily necessity and for fighting, if needed. The tomahawk was widely used by Native American tribes and is a symbol of both strength and skill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/1f1217df4c0a5091107d3c4ff928f31e180dccbf.png[/img]
[i]Selection of used references.[/i]

Aiyana’s leather hat is an inheritance from her colonist mother. One of the most interesting details we’ve implemented into her new look is the change to Aiyana's initial black hair. Dark brown-black hair is a typical attribute for Native women, but since Aiyana’s mother is a colonist, we painted the tips of her hair a lighter color, almost blondish. The blonder tips typically appear in women of mixed backgrounds - yet another subtle nod to our protagonist’s heritage. 

We decided against the more traditional Native American braid for Aiyana and instead went a slightly different route. Aiyana now wears her hair in some braids (not historically accurate) with looser hairs to again represent both sides of her family.

Aiyana's props were reworked to better reflect the materials available at the time, along with appropriate bead patterns. Even though backpacks were not exactly a thing, we imagined what a backpack could have looked like by taking inspiration from different handbags.

In summary, we put a great deal of thought and care into updating Aiyana’s design to better represent her background and show a greater respect to the inspirations that help breathe life into the world of Above Snakes. We hope you enjoy her new look as much as we all enjoyed creating it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/e6601161c041374a987ada6d44012e432b3f86f3.png[/img]
[i]Steam Cover Art[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/6a46329373d5b2417755ca1a1b511735f8ee27f7.png[/img]
[i]Alternative Artwork[/i]

Please note that we will not be removing the old design associated with the game. We love and celebrate our initial rendition of Aiyana and will simply refer to that design as "Alpha Artwork." We want to encourage content creators, media, and fans to use the new design going forward when showcasing Above Snakes content.

Let us know your thoughts below! As always, thank you for following along on this incredible journey.

Cheers,
Tobi

notes.title: 🐴 Devlog #9 - Corpse Creek and Horse Riding
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/10db0b574372350584e57cb5a645313464ca110a.png[/img]
[h2]Howdy and welcome to the first Above Snakes devlog of 2023![/h2]

We're excited to give you a sneak peek of one of the final biomes in our game: an epic, wild Western town called Corpse Creek. Corpse Creek plays a significant part in the story of Above Snakes and is a place you may discover towards the end of the game. We have also implemented horses, made adjustments to the cooking system, and have some other exciting features to showcase this month!

[h1]Watch the Devlog on YouTube[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V_BI9fL_K_s
[h2]Corpse Creek[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/45340523ad4e2e2bf89f7cb053b3a2f7965a8d96.png[/img]

Corpse Creek is a gigantic Western town and the fateful place where the plague first started. It is largely a ghost town now, as many of those who had survived fled from there. We don't want to give away too much just yet, because we want players to experience the biome for themselves.
Corpse Creek, despite recent events, still has inhabited buildings. However, the streets are littered with debris and the overall environment is eerie and atmospheric. It is sure to be a unique experience for players. We're putting forth a lot of effort into making this biome feel special. We're also adding interesting characters who will have their own stories to share with you. Our hope is that these characters help to add depth to the game. Byrd the bartender, for example, might already be familiar to those in our Community Discord server.

[h2]Horse Riding[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/88b28a9d3b6e2f5cd88e60a503df2ba2e2bae737.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/1c3fc81454f0af8f1c5ae26482e57bbe451b44de.png[/img]

What kind of Western game would Above Snakes be if there were no horses? You can now find hitching posts with horses in certain places throughout the world that you can use for fast travel. For instance, there is a post located at the trading post, the tribal village in the birch forest, and Corpse Creek. 
Using a horse costs carrots, but it's a great way to get around quickly. Carrots can be found in the wild and/or cultivated in your garden plots. Additionally, you can build your own hitching post at your base and own your very own horse!

[h2]Cooking System Improvements[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/fb4a0bcf317f2a83014c4d8e931ad19f34d4dce5.png[/img]

We've revamped the cooking system so that you now need to discover recipes before you can cook specific dishes. Discovery works by throwing ingredients together. After you have cooked a meal that results in a certain recipe, the recipe is "discovered" and added to your recipe book. For those of you who like to collect things, there are now books that you can find (or purchase) that teach you the recipes for certain items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/c475d6a3e2b6502447e0632e7c3334025a5453e6.png[/img]

Of course, you can still throw every ingredient together, even if they won’t result in a certain recipe. For those, the sprites are now color-coded and icon-coded depending on the stats they provide. This makes it a lot easier to identify such things on your hot bar. We've also made it so that items that don't "make sense" to be cooked together will now result in inedible meals. For example, if you throw a couple of bones in a bowl, you can’t expect it to be an edible meal.

[h2]Multiple Save Slots[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/487d2094cec15188b76f2e7901b338306681f778.png[/img]

There's no longer a need to delete your saved game! We've added the ability to have multiple save slots. You can now have up to 3 saved games at a time with story progression shown for each game.

[h2]Performance Improvements[/h2]

Lastly, we've made some big performance improvements to the game. We've reduced the initial loading time when starting up the game from around 30 seconds to just a couple of seconds! Now, you don't have to worry about the "black screen of death" anymore when starting the game (Beta testers know what I mean). We've also made some improvements to the memory management of the game, which means it now uses a lot less RAM. If you are an Alpha or Beta tester and were not able to run the game, now is a good time to try again. Let us know how it's running!

We hope you're as excited about these updates as we are! I can already tell you that we have a couple big announcements planned for the next few weeks! As always, we're looking for your feedback so please let us know in the comments what you think of Corpse Creek, the new horse riding, and the updated cooking system!

Cheers,
Tobi

[h1]Howdy Adventurers![/h1]
We hope you are having a wonderful holiday season and are ready for some exciting news from the world of Above Snakes. Firstly, we are changing our devlog format a little bit. This new format will be a blend of both written information and videos rather than showcasing one big video. In this specific devlog, one of the key features we're developing - base building improvements - gets its own special video. This mix will allow us to go in-depth into one feature per devlog. Let us know if you enjoy this format!

[h2]Base Building Improvements[/h2]
We've made some terrific improvements regarding our base building system, most notably by adding more gameplay value. To do this, we've attached a shelter system to the base fundamentals that provides shelter perks per level. This will encourage deeper gameplay when considering building a better (and stronger) shelter. Keep in mind that this system focuses on the quality of your shelter, not necessarily how grand or big it is. 

Shelter perks, for instance, will include fortified walls that provide greater safety from outside elements, better soil for quicker crops,  improved crafting stations that will operate more efficiently, and deeper wells which can offer more water.

We've also added junk items with their sole purpose of being sold to traders along the way. Our goal is to add more Wild West flavor to the game by implementing objects such as horseshoes, a deck of cards, pocket watches, and more! Let us know what you would like to find when looting.

In addition to junk items, we've also added traders to the game. Traders will offer various kinds of goods and are happy to pay for some items you may not necessarily need. Keep in mind that traders may sometimes have discounts or price hikes.

Conversations with characters are a significant part of Above Snakes. We're proud to have updated the conservation system which will now feature sound mid-conversation. These sounds may reflect items being given to Aiyana or its payment.

Additionally, we've updated nearly every character's portrait! As you can see, we've transitioned from grayscale portraiture to more detailed and colorful depictions of the characters you'll come across in Above Snakes.

The Square Glade Games team has determined that running closed tests from time to time is a good way to playtest a game. In addition to gaining priceless feedback, the team can decide if we're on the right track or not. For supporters who have already received a key as a result of Alpha access, start up Above Snakes like normal on Steam and install the update to Beta status on December 16th. We will inform you all in a separate update that the Beta keys have been sent!

We hope that you enjoyed this devlog as much as we have enjoyed implementing all of this new content. We look forward to stepping into Beta together. Thank you to everyone for your support. We can’t wait to see you play the Above Snakes Beta and hear your opinions on it!

notes.title: Devlog #7 - Welcome to the Desert 🏜️
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/346c25f80a75bb6c38579612742825982fb572f2.png[/img]

[h1]Howdy Adventurers![/h1]
Watch our latest devlog to see the beauty of our new desert biome, new skeleton enemies, a new tutorial area, the new quest log, and the addition of Steam cloud saves!

[h2]Video Devlog[/h2]
[previewyoutube=XCfmI2JeF5w;full][/previewyoutube]

Pssst..for more updates, don't forget to [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCTtZYMB_Wgi8GBiGZ4o-j-Q?sub_confirmation=1?sub_confirmation=1]subscribe to our YouTube Channel[/url].

[h2]Desert Biome[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/d6bd75618ae386615c3836852b04fa497d8828fd.jpg[/img]

After you complete the farmland quest line, your journey leads you into the desert where you will find a lone gunman called Mr. Jones. Mr. Jones has been heavily injured by something, but he blacked out before he could determine what it was. It turns out that green meteors and a spreading plague are not the only supernatural things happening in this world...

[h2]New Enemies [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/4cfb6ab1ebe277b1bd307d94ad76fe89c1b7e98b.jpg[/img]

We have created a handful of new enemies with the focus on making them interesting to play against. We spotted issues with the existing enemies, such as that dodging bullets and predicting attacks was very hard to do. We have tackled that issue with better animations, predictable attack patterns, and red lines that indicate where an attack will damage.
With these machete skeletons, gunmen, and dynamite throwers, we have a cool arsenal of skeleton enemy types that are more exciting to face - especially when you have to fight multiple at once! To see some gameplay, check out the video version of the devlog.

[h2]New Tutorial Area: Hunter's Rest[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/7f00829cb88e0f668f488fff0b31078e64fee28f.jpg[/img]

In our earlier tutorial, you started on a fairly empty world piece. We had designed tutorial quests in a way where you - the player - essentially took them upon yourself. For example, “I should get some lumber to build my shelter” or “I am hungry so I should collect berries.” While this approach works for many survival games, in Above Snakes we want to handle things a little differently.
 We want you to be able to experience the world of Above Snakes - and its happenings - firsthand. With that said, we designed a special area for that initial occasion: a lumberjack settlement called Hunter’s Rest. Hunter's Rest has been afflicted and damaged by the meteors and plague on the very night of its occurrence. You will now wake up in a near-destroyed town and help the survivors rebuild the settlement.

[h2]Quest Log[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/f8aaf3be8c475221cc9c61c4a21d3b381f3842f2.jpg[/img]

We always show your current quests on the left side of the UI, but sometimes that can get a little messy when you have too many quests at once. So, we have added a new UI called the Quest Log in which you can decide what quest to track (or not). You can also re-read the quest texts in case you missed them. 

[h2]Steam Cloud Saves[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/cb1a2c8d0f57d8e69e468336f923fb3bc75deb10.jpg[/img]

Additionally, we have enabled Steam cloud saves and will use that once the Beta is rolled out. We are currently working on making the save files compatible with the Steam Deck too, so you can seamlessly play on the same save file across all of your devices. Stay tuned and don’t miss when we announce the transition into Beta in the near future!

We hope that you enjoyed this devlog as much as we enjoyed implementing all of this content. We can't wait to hear your feedback. In the video, we asked what you think would make for a fun enemy. [b]Let us know in the comments below![/b]

Cheers,
Tobi

notes.title: Devlog #6 - Farming 🧑‍🌾
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/3ed773cfe48e83cf44c8ef718b62f5adffa2c100.png[/img]
[h1]Howdy Adventurers![/h1]
Is there anything better than tending to your own garden on a relaxing summer evening? Well, good news for you! You will be able to do exactly that in Above Snakes! Watch our latest devlog to see our farming system in action, the beauty of our new farmland biome, and our first ever interactive cutscene!
[h2]Watch the Devlog[/h2]
[previewyoutube=XuNj-XvDWQ8;full][/previewyoutube]
Are you already [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCTtZYMB_Wgi8GBiGZ4o-j-Q?sub_confirmation=1?sub_confirmation=1]subscribed[/url] to our Youtube Channel? 

[h2]Farmland Biome[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/6e037c7c5f17e123270c9c8cd0c058ba8f51ddd1.png[/img]
 
One of the latest biomes that we have designed is the farmlands. These are one of the warmer biomes that can be connected to prairies. Some of the farmland biomes are owned by a new character called Basil Biggs. Basil has his own cattle ranch that, unfortunately, has been invaded by lost souls. You can choose to help him fight back against these enemies, repair the ranch, and also get his beloved cows (Patsy and Betsy) back after they had escaped.

[h2]Crop Farming[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/a72662ffa55db534c8d77858261710e09804be17.png[/img]
 
You can have your own crop farm at home! If you found a crop on your journeys, you can sow it on a garden plot and allow it to grow. After planting, make sure to water and fertilize any crops regularly to increase growth speed. You can check the status of the garden at any time. Crops grow in four stages: from seeds to saplings to plants to plants ready for harvest.

[h2]Nighttime and Torches[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/a7d7e91d48aefc8a5a05115341a12fa967b0876e.jpg[/img]
 
We have vastly improved the night mechanic. When nighttime originally descended, it was very dark but you were still able to see the whole screen; this version of night went against our whole idea. Therefore, we added a light radius around Aiyana and made the rest of the screen completely dark. You can enhance your light radius by crafting torches. Torches can be placed to illuminate an area or carried if you plan to explore at nighttime.

[h2]Monocular [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/6a006668d90e0633a6df9fb4438e5815131c1e4b.png[/img]
 
We have also added a new item which we think will come in handy: the monocular. Remember how, when you want to explore a new biome, you need to go back to your cartography table and research world pieces? Well, we think that you should also be able to do that mid-journey too. The new monocular item will grant you access to your cartography table from anywhere in the world for the cost of a couple pieces of glass and scrap parts.

[h2]Interactive Cutscenes[/h2]
Parts of the story of Above Snakes will be told in interactive cutscenes that take place in a dream-like space. After finishing the cold biomes, the tribe elder will invite you to smoke a pipe with them that transfers your mind into some kind of trance or dream state. This is the first of the cutscenes where you will get some vague information about the source of the spreading plague. [url=https://youtu.be/XuNj-XvDWQ8]Watch our devlog[/url] if you want to see a sneak peek of our first interactive cutscene!

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
As you have probably noticed, we are pushing out content for Above Snakes non-stop. We are continuing our work on the game and remain focused on the end goal. In the past couple of months, we have consistently updated the Alpha (and before that, the Pre-Alpha). We have come to realize that updating the Alpha takes time away from our development of Above Snakes with usually 1-2 weeks of polishing and bug fixing. We think that it is in everyone's best interest if we put our focus more so on completing the game before everything else and, therefore, invest these weeks in new content instead of preparing a build. 

With that said, we have decided to cease updates to the Alpha and, instead, are working on finishing the Beta. This decision will also see the addition of more content per devlog. We are currently on schedule with our progress and are aiming to enter the Beta phase this winter; we will see plenty of new people joining the fun who had backed with Beta access. We sincerely hope that everybody who backed the Alpha understands why we are now moving forward. The current version of the Alpha, of course, stays online and can be played until we launch the Beta.

We hope that you enjoyed our farming devlog and we can't wait to hear your feedback. In the video, we showed all of the different crops that are already in-game. [b]What crop do you want to sow and harvest most? Let us know in the comments below![/b]
Cheers,
Tobi

notes.title: ❄️ Devlog #5 - Snow Biome, New Character Model, and More!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/ceb398d81c5d95ba45ee008b580b93976653c201.png[/img]
 
[h1]Howdy Adventurers![/h1]
Who else needs a little cool down? Well, we have some frosty news to share with you and tons of new content! An updated Alpha version of Above Snakes has been published to Steam and is ready to play!

[h2]Watch the Devlog on YouTube[/h2]
Don't want to read the devlog or would like to see more in-game footage? Take a shortcut and watch the devlog on YouTube!
 
[previewyoutube=_7zRYy5CZl0;full][/previewyoutube]

If you haven't already, subscribe to our brand new YouTube channel! We plan on creating devlog videos with some extra content to accompany the written version. We'll also be uploading other exciting things there in between regular updates!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCTtZYMB_Wgi8GBiGZ4o-j-Q?sub_confirmation=1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/9752c2bc406cc83d3e90e457d1ff15150af975b4.png[/img][/url]

[h2]New Biomes, New Quests, and New Content![/h2]
We have added two more biomes: Snow Forest and Ice Lake along with a couple of story tiles on which you can meet new people who tell the story of Above Snakes. All in all, we have added a total of 10+ new quests and 10+ new tiles with tons of resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/088ff1437b1acae235d24369d13c90883ae4afc7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/6f39bf044136e623eed2f6da30fb2868c7465aa3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/3939d3b3d9f53f026bf2e0b2b7f1f4b2b143a404.png[/img]

[h2]New Character Model and Visible Equipment[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/26eddca2a0e9907ffa5f080295f523cabbe150e2.png[/img]

Even though our old character model looked really nice, it was necessary to switch to a new one for a couple of reasons. Firstly, we needed a modular character model to display equipped items on the body. The old one was not created in a modular way. Secondly, we really liked the low-poly look of the new model as it fits the art style of the game very well.

[h2]Bow and Arrow Combat[/h2]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/71945724270b656e19b30c4a6cf797956529648b.gif[/img]

We have implemented ranged combat and hunting! Our good old friend Stark, the lumberjack, will have a new quest for you. Once you inspect his hunting gear and talk to him about it, he will offer to teach you how to hunt. 
We have bound melee weapons to the left mouse button and ranged weapons to the right mouse button. In combat, you can switch seamlessly between the two. Controllers are, of course, also supported.

[h2]We've Started Localizing the Game![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/172cf30d2622a9ae05d6b93e728900f0fc50a3f5.gif[/img]

As promised with the Kickstarter, Above Snakes will be available in many languages. When you start up the game, you can now select your language preference. You will be able to see the extent to which that language has already been translated (the percentages will vary and will increase over time). We display any texts that are not yet translated in English.

[b]Disclaimer:[/b] Please don't expect too much at this point regarding the translations as we have only just begun translating the game. Additionally, we are working on a way to have more languages translated during the Alpha and Beta phases. Our plan is to get everything re-written and re-translated by professionals before release. Until then, we will probably rely on our network and any help from the community.

That concludes another update! As always, we are happy to hear your feedback about any and all changes we make to the game. Please feel free to leave a comment down below or hop into the discussions on our Discord server!
Cheers,
Tobi

notes.title: Devlog #1 - Preparing the Alpha!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/093c189120de27bf1bfcdbd1588d56339730c60c.png[/img]

[h1]Howdy everybody![/h1]
Today, I have great news to share with all of you. Above Snakes is ready to take the next step and will transition from Pre-Alpha to Alpha! In the last couple of months, we have worked very hard to bring you the new features that made it into the Alpha.

[h2]We Have a New Team Member![/h2]
First and foremost, I am happy to inform you about our new team member, [b]Marc[/b]. Marc joined the Above Snakes team in February as both a Developer and Level/Game Designer. He has been hard at work ever since and I am sure that many of you have already talked to him on our [url=discord.gg/HwBgTMr4WU]Discord server[/url]. I wanted to wait for the first official Devlog for Above Snakes to introduce Marc - so be sure to say hello to him!

[i]Marc has a background in Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, and Autonomous vehicles. He is currently living in Florida where he programs self-driving vehicles, but his roots lie in Groningen (Netherlands) which, coincidentally, is the city I live in! Marc has loved gaming ever since the Nintendo 64 came out and has played a wide range of games on PC and all types of consoles. He has been very excited to become a co-developer of Above Snakes where he’s able to apply his programming and design skills in a different field.[/i]

[h2]When Will the Alpha Be Shipped?[/h2]
The Alpha will be shipped to all backers who backed for “Play First” or higher and for those who acquired (or will acquire) the Pre-Alpha Access via BackerKit. As you have probably seen, this means that we are ahead of schedule for the Alpha! Originally, we planned to prepare a content patch for the current Pre-Alpha and ship the Alpha later on. In the middle of the process, we decided that our time is better invested updating the core game features that we received feedback on.
By the way, if you backed on Kickstarter on a lower tier and want to join the Alpha, you can upgrade your pledge! Just write an e-mail to [url=mailto:abovesnakes@icloud.com]abovesnakes@icloud.com[/url]  or get the alpha via this link:

[url=https://abovesnakes.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders][img url=]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/740fe3b2a2bbc464dcbe1417d8abcf96e1fc9943.png[/img][/url]


So, let’s talk about the contents of the Alpha!

[h1]The Alpha Update[/h1]

[h2]New Tile System[/h2]
One of the biggest changes in the Alpha is the way in which tiles are spawned. In the Pre-Alpha, we recognized the problems that the pre-generated biome map had in determining where and which biomes could be spawned. Rather than relying on the pre-generated map for the player to uncover, we decided to leave this decision entirely to the player. We also ensured that biomes now display proper transitions between one another to generate a believable and natural-looking world.

[h2]Matching and Blending Biomes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/5e98b0bbfac4968acaa18b038ba4392e0d0f1fb5.png[/img]
In addition to the full-tile biomes, these new mixed-biome tiles (or “transition biomes”) have been added to the game. They can (and need) to be used by players to properly transition between different biomes, all while making sure that the edges of each adjacent biome match. This tile update should add more depth to gameplay and make the world that you build more complex.

This is an example of how tiles can be combined and transitioned between one another.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/9546be34f2bd0416639eb00cbb32fa24cfb9bd83.png[/img]

 
[h2]Cartography System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/376265c1716b247bf199686e15f769de9e821363.png[/img]
 
The updated tile system comes together with the new [b]cartography system[/b]. In order to make new tiles, you will first have to discover and research them. You can do that on the cartography table - a new item you can craft. Each researched tile is added to your tile pool. From your tile pool, you can choose which tiles are in your current selection and can subsequently be spawned. You choose which tiles you want to spawn, but make sure to select the ones that match your current biomes!

[h2]Scouting[/h2]
We also redid the process of tile placing. In the Pre-Alpha, you paid in certain resources to make a tile. Since we moved these costs to tile research, we added a new mechanic to create new tiles: [b]scouting[/b]. You scout your environment by interacting with it (collect berries, chop trees, harvest rocks, etc.) and, once you have scouted your environment enough, you can create a new tile from your tile selection.

[h2]Updated Tile Aesthetic[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/c4b9d73ea653c2d0ae54adfb522ac3145acfab8b.png[/img]

While reworking the tile system, we also updated the aesthetics of the tiles by updating the technology with which we create those. The surface of the tile can now contain up to 4 textures that can blend seamlessly into another (before it was limited to 1 texture with no blending). Also, we can now sculpt the surface of the tiles to create more natural-looking mountains, rivers, lakes, etc.

[h2]Rogue-lite vs. Continuous Mode[/h2]
We asked players which mode they liked more: the [b]rogue-lite[/b] (in which you loose your world) or the [b]continuous mode[/b] (in which everything will still be there, even after death). The overwhelming majority of players decided for the continuous mode.  With this feedback, we decided to remove the rogue-lite mode for now. We will discuss at a later point in time whether this mode will come back and, if so, how.
Please note, that we will be adding death penalties to the game (right now, dying is basically free).
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/10ba7746aa5cbfb4a6d56ab2e30ffee3e172a2c2.png[/img]

[h2]New Cooking System[/h2]
We also updated the [b]cooking system[/b] which was working similarly to the crafting system (use X and Y to make Z). The new cooking system requires you to combine up to three ingredients. Depending on how well the ingredients go together, your cooked meal will have certain stats. If you match the "right" ingredients together, you can create a recipe which provides you with extra stats and, sometimes, useful buffs! It is up to you to find out the recipes!
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/8e86ca68fb309b985f7ea4bdc61aadcd7aff3c28.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/655f6722c8a229100ef7b68718ccc48c7827658b.png[/img]
 
[h2]New Tutorial and Quests[/h2]
The whole tutorial was removed from the game and replaced with a more interesting quest system. When starting the game, you will receive certain tasks that help you with survival. Those tasks increase in difficulty but offer less explanations as time goes on. The first tasks will explain the basic hotkeys and mechanics of the game while later tasks will only ask you to do certain things. It will be up to you to discover the rest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/d6c3307b53011140f27543a968d8376cf2a65ae9.png[/img]
 
[h2]Performance Updates[/h2]
[previewyoutube=66cwD9erntA;full][/previewyoutube]
We received feedback from a couple of players that the performance of the game decreased with the number of tiles spawned. Also, PCs with smaller graphics chips were not able to start the game at all (sometimes stuck in the title screen) due to the way the grass in-game was rendered. We worked on improving these things and added GPU instancing to heavily reduce draw calls of grass. Additionally, we also worked with occlusion and frustum culling to improve performance with the increasing number of tiles. We will continue to work on the performance as this is not yet perfect, but we are happy with the achieved results and were able to measure big improvements in FPS.

[h2]New Music[/h2]
Our amazing composer, [url=https://tylerzanemusic.com/]Tyler Cline[/url], has created new music for Above Snakes! This new piece is the exploration theme that plays during nighttime. Have a listen:
[url=https://soundcloud.com/tyler-cline-575720561/a-1]A long Night in the West on Soundcloud[/url]

[h2]And More![/h2]
There is plenty more to discuss, but that would make this Devlog waaaay too long. Therefore, here is a list of things that are worth mentioning (short and sweet)! If you want to know more about a certain item on the list, please do not hesitate to ask!

[list]
[*] Brand new Character UI that shows Aiyana’s stats.
[*] A new look for the backpack UI.
[*] Farm biome with farm animals.
[*] New wildlife (i.e. boars and penguins).
[*] New lost soul: the crawler.
[*] Day and night cycle is now attached to tile creation.
[*] Removed tile stats.
[*] Fish can now be chopped into fish meat which can be used to cook.
[*] Trees can now have bee hives attached to them.
[*] Water bottle is now an equipped item and not loose in the inventory.
[*] Ice picking for fishing holes.
[*] Berry bushes regrow.
[*] Hammer and map are now items that need to be acquired, not just hotkeys.
[*] Many UX and UI improvements.
[*] More storylines and enemies will be revealed soon!
[/list]

Thanks again for supporting Above Snakes and being a part of our community. As always, please don’t hesitate to ask questions or provide feedback here or on our [url=discord.gg/HwBgTMr4WU]Discord server[/url].

Cheers,
Tobi

notes.title: Let's talk Buildings!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/016ca3c4138da97d22e0a15985374187984adf46.png[/img]

[h2]Hello Adventurers![/h2]

Today, I would love to go a little more into the building system and explain both the basics and possibilities of the feature. It all starts with a foundation that you can place freely on the ground, as long as you stay on your center tile. To build bigger homes, you can simply snap foundations together. It is as easy as it sounds! So every foundation can have 4 more foundations snapped to it (and so on). By the way: You can rotate foundations to create nice floor patterns!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/054763b0d9e59c1ed8b9653a78b4db46c7a5e5b4.png[/img]

Each foundation can also have 4 walls that snap to its edges. It is not possible to have multiple walls on the same edge though - you have to choose!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/648ceaea41d65fc201ea650cc885790959b5425f.png[/img]

If you have at least 1 supporting wall, you can add a roof to your build. A roof will provide shelter and subsequently protect you from rain and other forces of nature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/e956dfb475431af0b9416079e36a4a2ebb11bee1.png[/img]

I really like the simplicity of this building system but, at the same time, love how creative you can be with it. It is really easy to create a simple, small cabin for shelter if you are not into building. But for those who enjoy adding a bit more customization to their spaces, you can put hours into building a big house if you want to live in something special! There are already a lot of different building parts available and more and more will be added with ongoing development!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/3062f1f73485745757d26e8721a5d3de2aa67adc.png[/img]

I hope you enjoyed this little explanation of the building system! What building part should be added next? Let me know in the comments below!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/e14886ef39c2b46b92af923a1f82e6833b5d98c7.png[/img]

I am super excited to announce that Above Snakes participates in the Steam Next Festival! That means that there is a demo of the game available for download during that time! You can get it for free on the Above Snakes Steam Page between June 16 and June 22.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1589120/Above_Snakes][b]Get the demo here.[/b][/url]

The demo contains a sneak peek of some of the systems the the full game will provide. You can explore a sandbox environment and fill it with your own unique world made of tiles. While doing so you need to keep track of your needs, build a small camp, harvest, sow and cook food, find sources of water and build weapons to defend yourself against wild animals or even worse things.

Included features of the demo (excerpt):

- 50+ different items
- 25+ different tiles in 10 biomes
- 5 story tiles
- 3 Quests
- 3 Enemy types
- 2 Weapons
- Cooking and crafting (very limited items)
- Sowing and harvesting
- Day and night cycle

I hope you enjoy the demo and it would be of much value if you could provide your feedback or suggestions through a steam review or at one of the social media channels of Above Snakes: [url=https://discord.gg/HwBgTMr4WU]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/goldenaxebremen]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/abovesnakesgame/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/abovesnakesgame/]Facebook[/url]
